meta.company: Elis SA (ELIS FP; S&P C_27989; ProntoNLP 27989)
meta.sources: ProntoNLP and S&P Capital IQ only; citations copied verbatim from tool responses (see provenance/raw/G_business_model and logs/G_business_model.md)
meta.tier_convention: -3 raw materials, -2 manufacturers, -1 direct inputs, 0 Elis operations, 1 customer segments, 2 end users; 'stakeholder'/'context' for non-flow actors
meta.caveats: Supplier names are largely undisclosed in permitted sources; '[calc]' = derived by agent; transcript brackets kept as transcribed.

nodes.name: Fibres & raw materials (cotton, polyester incl. recycled polyester)
nodes.relationship: Indirect input to textile suppliers; price risk passes through 1-year fixed textile prices
nodes.notes: Cotton/raw-material price spikes can make fixed one-year textile prices unacceptable to suppliers [#1975](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-1975); some workwear ranges use 65-100% recycled polyester [#519](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-519). No fibre suppliers named in permitted sources.

nodes.name: External textile & garment manufacturers (flat linen, workwear, mats)
nodes.relationship: Direct purchases (central/PCO and local/PLO master agreements); tenders once or twice a year; prices fixed 1 year vs binding estimates; suppliers hold buffer stock for Elis
nodes.notes: Purchases of textile & HWB products: Europe 37%, Asia 36%, Africa ~14%, Latin/South America 7.5% [#4026](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4026); 15 largest textile suppliers >25% of direct-supplier spend [#2946](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-2946); Top-100 suppliers >78% of direct purchases [#4080](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4080); tenders 1-2x/yr [#1985](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-1985); buffer inventory [#1996](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-1996); Asia-sourced linen [#75](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-75). Supplier names not disclosed.

nodes.name: Elis own manufacturing & design (captive)
nodes.relationship: Owned subsidiaries supplying garments, table linen and hygiene appliances to the Group

named_companies.name: Le Jacquard Français (France, table/household linen)
Kennedy Hygiene (UK, hygiene appliance production plant)
Workwear manufacturing plant in Estonia (650,000 items per year)
Clothing manufacturing plants in Brazil, Mexico, Colombia and Malaysia
Design centres in France and Sweden; garment customisation/repair workshops

nodes.notes: 'Other' reporting segment includes manufacturing entities, holdings and Asia [#5348](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-5348).

nodes.name: Hygiene & well-being appliances and consumables (dispensers, paper, soap, water fountains, coffee)
nodes.relationship: Direct purchases (HWB); some captive suppliers

named_companies.name: Malongo (coffee; partnership described as captive supplier)
Kennedy Hygiene (own appliance plant)

nodes.notes: Ecolabel-certified paper for hand-towel/toilet dispensers (supplier unnamed) [#4562](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4562). ProntoNLP peer model also lists Bunzl plc and Paul Hartmann AG under 'supplier' but with competitor-style reasons; not corroborated (see raw 001).

nodes.name: Industrial laundry equipment (tunnel washers, dryers, ironers/calenders, boilers)
nodes.relationship: Framework agreements for industrial equipment; captive/oligopoly supply
nodes.notes: 'suppliers of industrial laundry or traceability equipment' cited as captive (monopoly/oligopoly) [#1976](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-1976); framework agreements [#1998](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-1998); some equipment refurbished and reinstalled [#2766](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-2766). Manufacturer names not available.

nodes.name: Traceability / RFID / IT systems
nodes.relationship: Captive suppliers for traceability equipment; in-house software (GLAD routing, eForce CRM)
nodes.notes: RFID traceability roll-out [#680](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-680); captive traceability-equipment suppliers [#1976](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-1976); GLAD in-house routing tool [#3186](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-3186); eForce CRM roll-out [#553](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-553). Vendor names not available.

nodes.name: Chemicals & cleaning products (detergents, bleaching agents, CO2 for neutralisation)
nodes.relationship: Framework agreements for production inputs such as cleaning products
nodes.notes: Framework agreements [#1998](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-1998); fuel, paper and chemicals inflation = EUR 7m cost impact in H1 2026 [#75](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-75); CO2 recovered from fumes replaces purchased CO2 for wastewater neutralisation [#484](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-484). Supplier names not available.

nodes.name: Energy (natural gas, electricity)
nodes.relationship: Purchasing agreements in all countries; centrally hedged (layered, up to N+3)
nodes.notes: Energy = 6-7% of revenue [#614](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-614); ~EUR 190m energy bill expected 2026 [#446](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-446); hedges 2026 93% gas/94% electricity, 2027 81%/87%, 2028 61%/53% (Jul-2026) [#76](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-76); agreements in all countries [#284](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-284). Utility names not available.

nodes.name: Water (municipal networks, groundwater, surface water) & wastewater treatment
nodes.relationship: Withdrawal and discharge under permits; most laundries connected to municipal wastewater networks
nodes.notes: 'Availability of water resources is a major criterion' [#2017](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-2017); municipal network connection [#4702](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4702); French prefectural orders set withdrawal/discharge limits [#4791](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4791).

nodes.name: Vehicles & fuel (delivery fleet)
nodes.relationship: Fleet purchased/leased from vehicle manufacturers; fuel purchased locally
nodes.notes: Over 11,800 vehicles (~65% deliveries) [#3097](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-3097); works with vehicle designers/manufacturers (unnamed) to reduce weight [#3181](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-3181); transition to biogas/biodiesel/electric [#86](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-86).

nodes.name: Labour (plant operators, drivers/service agents, sales)
nodes.relationship: Employees (58,445 per S&P Capital IQ); temporary/annualised-hours contracts used for flexibility
nodes.notes: 60% of costs related to labour [#3309](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-3309); 2026 wage inflation ~4% group [#703](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-703); minimum wage +23% Colombia, +13% Mexico (2026) [#147](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-147). Headcount: S&P Capital IQ (C_27989), source link unavailable.

nodes.name: Central purchasing & supply chain (category management, PCO/PLO suppliers, European warehouses, CLIP programme)
nodes.relationship: Selects/approves suppliers, master agreements, multi-sourcing, inventory of best-sellers

named_companies.name: Elis SA (Group Purchasing Department)

nodes.notes: Centralised purchasing with local buyers [#1975](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-1975); warehouses in Europe, CLIP programme [#1995](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-1995); three group workwear warehouses with personalisation [#425](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-425).

nodes.name: Laundries / processing centres (>373) incl. cleanroom plants
nodes.relationship: Washing, finishing, repair, quality control; plants generally 30-100 km from customers
nodes.notes: 'over 373 laundries' [#2031](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-2031); France: 69 plants and 46 distribution centres [#1074](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-1074); 30-100 km radius [#3179](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-3179); full plant build 12-14 months, lead time driven by real-estate/licensing [#381](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-381).

nodes.name: Route-based logistics (deliver clean / collect soiled)
nodes.relationship: Fixed delivery routes; trucks full in both directions
nodes.notes: >6,000 routes per day, 5m km per week [#286](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-286); 'full vehicles in both directions' [#3180](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-3180); GLAD routing [#3186](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-3186); logistics insourcing [#3098](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-3098).

nodes.name: Sales, key accounts & customer care (incl. SME salesforce, eForce CRM)
nodes.relationship: Contracting (typically 4-year initial term), renewals (HiFi programme), cross-selling
nodes.notes: 4-year initial term, termination fee ~ residual value [#1946](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-1946); >25% of sales via salesforce dedicated to small customers (up to 60% in France/Southern Europe) [#614](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-614).

nodes.name: Specialty services: pest control (13 countries), cleanroom (21 countries), medical waste, beverages
nodes.relationship: Cross-sold service lines
nodes.notes: Cleanroom FY2025 EUR 275m (+8.5%) [#129](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-129); Pest control ~EUR 80m (~+9%) [#133](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-133); country coverage [#139](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-139).

nodes.name: Repair, refurbishment, reuse & recycling of end-of-life items
nodes.relationship: Extends product life; end-of-life textiles recycled (wipes, insulation, textile-to-textile pilots) or donated
nodes.notes: >87% of used flat linen recycled, 77% as wipes [#4617](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4617); partnerships with textile recycling players (unnamed) [#4607](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4607); repair/refurbishing units [#4757](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4757).
